identity: Nova — the clean, neutral Tanqory starter. Near-black ink on white, restrained blue accent, serif display over Inter body, balanced spacing. Deliberately unopinionated so any brand can be applied on top.
voice: Clear, neutral, modern commerce. No slang, no hype.
invariants: stay legible and neutral — personality comes from the merchant brand, not the theme
never remove the framework token structure
keep balanced spacing — neither dense nor editorial-airy
safeToChange: all colors and fonts via brand tokens
